name: W Mexico City
positioning: A playful, design-heavy hotel in Polanco next to Lincoln Park, with art-filled rooms and a spa with a pre-Hispanic Temazcal
best_for: Travelers who want a fun, high-energy base in Polanco near Avenida Presidente Masaryk
Spa-goers curious about a traditional Temazcal ritual

facts.text: The hotel is off Reforma Boulevard in the Polanco neighborhood, known for chic shops, culture and nightlife.
AWAY Spa offers massages, aromatherapy, and hot stone or European-style therapy.
Bathrooms have floor-to-ceiling black-and-white tile and natural light.
Rooms have the signature W bed with a down duvet and 350-thread-count linens.
The FIT gym is open 24/7 on the 4th floor.

highlights.text: Every room has quirky touches such as an oversized mural by Mexican artist Ivan Aguirre and an infinity mirror above the bed filled with alebrijes and miniature toys.
The spa has a Temazcal, an ancient pre-Hispanic ritual.
Public spaces are dimly lit with pops of color, neon backlighting and abstract furniture such as oversized busts used as lobby seating.
The hotel is next to Lincoln Park in Polanco, within easy walking distance of Avenida Presidente Masaryk and its high-end boutiques.
The spa offers a mixed hydrotherapy circuit.

considerations.text: Some guests may not appreciate the noise and club-like atmosphere in common spaces and restaurants, especially on weekends.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the contemporary lifestyle style may not suit travelers who prefer traditional luxury.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: W Mexico City
